US Takes Seriously Iran Dirty Bomb Plot Reports; Nvidia Faces China Chip Scrutiny

Reports indicate the US is taking seriously allegations of an Iranian plot to use a dirty bomb against Washington D.C. The US has also reportedly struck Iran's Qeshm Island following drone attacks targeting Bahrain, ending a two-month lull in strikes on US targets in Bahrain. Meanwhile, Nvidia has warned chip buyers of legal risks associated with China's access to AI technology, as the US probes loopholes that could give China access to Nvidia's computing power. This comes amid broader US-China rivalry in the AI race and concerns over Nvidia's revenue reporting in Singapore.
